allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'No Deviation statement on QIP Proceeds '.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates about approved the issue and allotment of 7,11,00,000 Equity Shares of face value of INR 1 each to eligible qualified Institutional buyers at an issue price of INR 227 per Equity Share.

allot.subject: Committee Meeting Updates
allot.text: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Committee Meeting held on July 28, 2026 w.r.t. closure of QIP issue

allot.subject: Committee Meeting Updates
allot.text: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Committee Meeting held on July 23, 2026 to approve preliminary placement document for QIP.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates - approved raising of funds by way of issuance of equity shares through qualified institutional placement for an aggregate amount not exceeding Rs. 2000 crores, representing an enhancement of earlier approved limit from Rs. 1000 crore to Rs. 2000 crore, subject to the approval of the shareholders and other statutory approval
